slug: 2025-08-28 Nigeria to launch National Data Exchange (NGDX) platform to boost digital economy

facts.fact: The Nigerian government is preparing to launch the NGDX data-sharing platform between government agencies and businesses, expected operational by end 2025, as discussed at an Abuja workshop on 25 August 2025.

NITDA held a stakeholders' workshop in Abuja on the Nigerian Data Exchange Platform (NGDX), described as a unified data exchange system for government institutions being rolled out, backed by the EU; no connected bodies or volumes are given.

facts.fact: An EU-funded EUR 23m agreement signed by the European Commission, ESTDEV and HAUS provides for ESTDEV to create a data exchange framework and layer based on Estonia's X-Road in Nigeria, with NITDA, NIMC, NDPC, Galaxy Backbone and FMCIDE collaborating over about three years.

Two Gofore consultants seconded through HAUS set up the first X-Road instance in the Nigerian Data Exchange Centre (NGDX) local data centre in Abuja, with MDAs met as potential members and target use cases agreed but not yet live.
